_comment: Shared test fixture for src/predict.ts and web/src/predict.ts. Those two files are hand-duplicated because src/ and web/src/ are separate TypeScript projects that cannot import from each other (see CLAUDE.md's note on WireVehicle: 'nothing enforces' the two copies staying in sync). Nothing type-checks that predict.ts and its web copy compute the same thing -- this fixture is what enforces it: both src/predict.test.ts and web/src/predict.test.ts read this exact file and assert the exact same expected values, so the two copies drifting apart fails both test suites.

speedCases.name: a normally moving bus has a positive forward speed
a bus with no previous fix has no observed speed
a stationary bus at a layover reports zero speed
backwards travel between two fixes produces a negative speed
an implausible speed is rejected as no usable observation
zero time delta between fixes returns a null speed
a previous fix newer than the last one returns a null speed

confidenceCases.name: no age at all means full confidence
a fix from the future (negative age) is still full confidence
fades linearly toward 0.6 at the midpoint of one poll interval
reaches 0.6 at exactly one poll interval old
fades linearly toward 0.35 at the midpoint of the second poll interval
reaches 0.35 at exactly two poll intervals old
stays at the 0.35 floor well beyond two poll intervals
a zero poll interval guards to full confidence
a negative poll interval guards to full confidence
